sentences.en: Regicide is a foil to the divine right of kings.
sentences.zh: 弑君罪是对王权神授的一种讽刺。

sentences.en: The man of wisdom sees the divine substance in everything.
sentences.zh: 明智之人会发现万物中都蕴含着神圣的本质。

sentences.en: No, my friend, one must never count on divine justice.
sentences.zh: 不，我的朋友，人们永远不能指望得到天谴的公正。
